integrity: The proof rewrites the Hermite segment as a linear functional of nonnegative data increments, proves the coefficient signs analytically, and optimizes the two remaining cubic shape factors exactly. The packaged standard-library checker replays the polynomial identities and exact rational special cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one scalar uniform cardinal cubic segment with slope factor between zero and the standard Catmull-Rom value. It does not cover nonuniform parameterizations, vector-valued curve containment, longer coupled spline constructions, or modified shape-preserving tangents. Older graphics literature may contain an equivalent constant under another formulation.
title: Sharp range defect of uniform Catmull–Rom interpolation
